body:
I'd like to take this one.

Looking at the code, the problem is in Tree::scroll_to_item()
(scene/gui/tree.cpp:6615). It computes the visible height as
area_size.height - title_button_height, without subtracting the sticky stack
height (sticky_stack_end). The scroll-up branch then puts the item at the very
top of the content area - which is exactly the band the sticky item covers, so
the item never actually scrolls out from under it. Tree::ensure_cursor_is_visible()
(:6345) already handles this correctly, and the two functions reference each
other with "in case of bug fix both" comments.

I'd sync the sticky handling into scroll_to_item() and fix both functions
together. For testing I'd cover a single sticky item, nested sticky items, and a
scroll that crosses the sticky boundary, plus Show in FileSystem in the
FileSystem dock.
